item: H79 - a structurally DIFFERENT starting basin, not a better one
question: Is there more than one starting construction to choose from at all, measured against the champion's OWN relabelling ball as the unit of 'same construction'?

novelty_gate.revival_condition_named: H56 revival_if (b): 'a mechanism is shown to WIDEN the labelling sigma past 0.021269 pp at the champion's current per-run cost'. A structurally different CONSTRUCTION is a prefix-level mechanism, and M10 states the only surviving door is one that widens the PREFIX's dispersion, which is where 96% of it lives.
novelty_gate.h48_constraint_respected: ratio_greedy is measured as a reference point only and is BLOCKED by name from any rung-2 arm ('never again as a drop-in warm start for the current stack').
novelty_gate.m15_argument: M15's operative directive requires an item whose mechanism is a new/extended MONOTONE move class on the existing basin to argue against M15. H79 is not such an item: it changes the basin rather than the move class, and M15 names it as one of the two surviving levels.

control: greedy_fas re-run on R=5 random node relabellings (exact isomorphism), mapped back to canonical ids

decision_rule.ball_tau_min: min pairwise Kendall tau over {canonical greedy_fas, ball_r1..ball_r5}
decision_rule.rung1_kill: < 2 admissible constructions distinct -> H79 dies here, kill entry written

rung2_if_pass.what: run the UNCHANGED connectome champion stack (H64) from each admissible distinct construction; report the SPREAD of refined scores, not the max
rung2_if_pass.kill_condition: refined-score spread <= 0.019124 pp (the measured relabelling nuisance sigma, M10) -> the stack erases the basin, which is M2/M6's shape, and the axis closes
rung2_if_pass.cost: 1 connectome run per arm at ~1250 s

stated_before_the_numbers: Distinct INITS do not imply distinct BASINS. M6, M2 and H48 all describe a stack that absorbs input differences (H48: 99.4% of a +5.70 pp init advantage). Rung 1 can only REFUSE; it cannot establish the basin is live.
leakage: No construction reads the oracle or data/best_solution. Nothing is written to results/.
